cross_component_finding: This page's body is a near-verbatim subset of fts-high-availability-for-search.md's own 'High Availability Indexes' and 'Server Groups/Rack zone awareness' sections (same batch) - but it ADDS one fact the parent overview page omits entirely: the 7.0.2 availableSince date for Server Group/rack-zone-aware replica placement ('Starting with Couchbase Server release 7.0.2, the Search service supports Server Groups/Rack zone aware replica placements.'). The parent page's own Server Groups section, by contrast, describes the mechanism in far more detail (optimum-distribution note, illustration, the auto-failover caveat) but never dates it. The two pages complement rather than simply duplicate each other.
